title: A5 instrument smoke test — INADMISSIBLE AS EVIDENCE
_smoke_note: NOT A RESULT AND NEVER QUOTABLE AS ONE. Eight rows per class, 8 atoms per domain, one dense resolution (28), gates bypassed. Its only job is to prove the code paths execute: parity guard, corpus, Arm D re-measured ridge, global whitener, per-domain dictionary construction, per-domain ridge heads, oracle + fingerprint routers, floor gate, and both kill switches evaluate. Every accuracy it produces is meaningless.

parity_guard.feature: CLS token concatenated with the mean of the patch tokens
